title: Cancelled after three boxes
text:
This subscription box gets a big -its OK- from me. Once I entered my preferences (illustration) the boxes came0with random drawing pens. But I wasn't happy with any of the pe?ms that arrived. I felt they weren't very special, or a great value. After three boxes I cancelled the subscription because what I have after those boxes amounts to the same selection if I shopped the clearance at hobby lobby.
Did everything sent work? Yes. Absolutely. No complaints there.
Do I want two yellow ink pens in the same shipment? No.
Did any cool tools or gadgets àrrive in those three boxes? No.
Where there any sets of pens? One. A set of GRAY markers.
Idunno. Perhaps my expectations for the price where too high.
Generally I was unimpressed for the value versus wow factor.
label: neutral
